SID AI Rilis SID-2, Model Pencarian Agentic dengan Skor NDCG 0,720

SID AI has released SID-2 , its second-generation agentic search model, alongside SID-2 Swarm. SID-2 is an agentic search model from SID AI that searches your data, reads results and returns ranked document IDs. It replaces fixed RAG pipelines with a model that decides what to search next. SID-2 is a small search specialist, not a general chat model. A static pipeline runs rewrite, embed, search and rerank in a fixed order. SID-2 instead searches, reads results, adapts and searches again . Developers implement the search tools against their own backend. A text_search tool covers keyword search and a search tool covers vector search. The model ends each episode by calling report_helpful_ids with a ranked list. No reindexing or data movement is required , since SID-2 only sees what your tools return. SID-2 Swarm runs several agents that message each other and fork their context into new agents. Each agent explores a separate slice of the corpus. SID argues search gains more from reading more documents than from reasoning harder about each one. SID-2 offers low, medium and high reasoning effort. Each level was trained as a separate expert, then merged with multi-teacher on-policy distillation. Metric Steering lets users target NDCG, F1 or Recall@k, with k from 1 to 50. On SID’s 506-question validation set, SID-2 at high effort scores 0.14 to 0.22 higher per metric than the base model. Training used 2-stage reinforcement learning. Stage 1 optimizes retrieval quality only. Stage 2 adds a multiplicative latency penalty that applies only to positive rewards. A proposer-solver self-play loop generated hard queries against a frozen SID-1 solver. SID reports a 6x training-throughput gain over SLIME’s default setup. SID built a 506-question benchmark across 19 corpora. These include HotpotQA, Enron emails, SEC filings, PubMed and BrowseComp-Plus. All numbers below are self-reported from Tables 2 to 4 of the report . Swarm leads on 11 of 19 corpora. On WixQA, a single high-effort agent matches Astra at about 232x lower cost. At its lowest effort, SID-2 beats 4 parallel SID-1 runs with 13x fewer FLOPs. NDCG, time and cost rows are measured by SID on its own benchmark. Retrieval backend time is excluded. SID-2 is available through SID’s API and on Baseten . SDKs exist for Python ( sid-sdk ), TypeScript ( @sid-ai/sid-sdk ) and Go ( github.com/sidhq/sid-go ). A SageMaker helper covers AWS deployments. The reference implementation uses the OpenAI client format. SID-2 costs $0.25 per million input tokens and $1.00 per million output tokens . Swarm costs $0.50 and $2.00. Cached input is 10% of the input price. Check out the SID-2 technical report , the docs and the model page .
